states: Embedded production builds (vite build into internal/api/frontend-modern/dist, go build) of the parent tree (3e6e9c3ffb, the merge of #2677 into #2695) and this tree, each on a private DEMO_MODE mock stack with a fresh data dir and its own port; the same Playwright script ran against both at both widths.

Patrol load, tab hide/show, forced stale-data banner and Retry: GET /api/ai/circuit/status goes from 1-2 requests per phase on the parent build to 0 on this build; every other /api endpoint per phase is identical, and neither build logs a console error.

Served active finding, Activity > Finding options and history, Resolve or dismiss > Open in Assistant: the Pulse Assistant drawer opens with the finding attached on both builds, with identical requests.

Patrol status forced to runtime_state blocked with blocked_cause circuit_open (page.route): both builds show 'Patrol paused' with 'circuit breaker is open', so breaker state still reaches the page through Patrol status alone.

Dist proof: 187 files each side; after normalising chunk hashes, SRI strings and short identifiers, only the removed store loader, signal, getter and API client differ in index.js and the removed supporting read in AIIntelligence.js; check-bundle-size.mjs passes.
interactions: Demo auto sign-in; on /patrol open the Activity tab and 'Finding options and history', expand the served finding, open 'Resolve or dismiss', click 'Open in Assistant', close the drawer.
Dispatch visibilitychange hidden then visible; reload with GET /api/settings/ai failing, then click Retry with the route restored; reload /patrol with a circuit_open Patrol status.
Desktop 1440x900 and phone 390x844 contexts; screenshots of the Patrol page, Assistant drawer, stale-data banner and paused banner inspected.
